cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 label professionalism, but claims of trained confession and recruiting do not demonstrate professional correction.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 admission becomes A3 training evidence; B4 hunger becomes A5 recruiting theory, connecting words but weakly grounding the larger problem.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 simply explain eating while A ignores practical resolution.

heightening.evidence: A5 broadens the conspiracy but contributes no concrete investigative development.

specificity.evidence: A1 two office biscuits and B2 eater are clear; the supposed organisation is only A inference.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 unnamed standard and A5 broad higher-than-tin line explain the suspicion more than act on it.
